### 3. Your Viewing Experience
Because the Moon is about 389,000 km away and nearly full, it will be the most dominant object in your sky. Even with "normal unaided eyesight," it won't be a subtle find; it will be a bright, glowing orb in the East-Southeast.

**Pro-tip for your viewing:**

Enjoy the view—it sounds like a perfect night for it!
